description: Are you an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for leadership and a commitment to exceptional patient care? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA, is seeking a dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead their clinical team. This vital role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and implementing best practices to achieve superior patient outcomes. You will play a key role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and maintaining a high standard of clinical excellence.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and dedication. Join a team committed to making a positive impact on the lives of their residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as DON or ADON
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated leadership, communication, and organizational skills
